[IRET.20.3] **`Json` slot ownership.** `Json`-typed slot
values hold a heap-allocated `ds_rete_json_t *`. The fact
that owns the slot owns the `Json` blob. On fact
retraction, the engine frees the `Json` blob before
freeing the fact. builtins that receive a `Json` value as an
argument receive a borrow; they must not free it.
